Freedom has nothing to fear from the truth.

The Judge Has His Own Medical Necessity:
McCormick Hearing Delayed Again -- Until Next Monday –
Special to Marijuananews

In an ironic twist, the Federal judge who is to rule on whether Todd McCormick and Peter McWilliams can use a medical necessity defense -- in keeping with the ruling by the 9th Circuit -- has had to delay the hearing again because of ill health. It has not been reported whether he has used any herbal remedies.
